scope: Milovice (multi-region OSM windows, with individually photo-matched landmarks chiefly around the old station center)
rule: Photographs are used solely as visual reference. No source photo pixels or proprietary Street View tiles are embedded in the game.

geoData.notes: Building outlines and mapped building:levels only; many missing roof/facade/material tags.

references.architecture: light brick neo-Gothic nave, square tall clock tower, dark round clock, red four-sided spire
references.precision: OSM footprint and verified GPS; facade details and tower heights are inferred/approximate

references.architecture: cream/ochre stucco, red ceramic tiles, gabled roofs, rain gutters, simple shuttered windows, narrow paved sidewalk

references.name: Milovická Nádražka – ground floor of station
references.architecture: Cafe within station waiting-room area; historical front garden and serving window, but neither exact exterior opening nor current 2026 layout is surveyed. Do not make a side annex or side cafe frontage.
references.precision: Station building footprint verified by OSM; cafe is an indoor amenity only. No standalone cafe geometry or side-wall placement verified.

references.name: Sídliště Mladá – blue/gray panelák character

references.name: Braniborská – pale yellow apartment block

references.precision: Visual reference for similar residential building archetypes only; proprietary listing photo is not embedded as an in-game texture

references.name: Rakouská – modern terraced housing

references.precision: Area style guide only. Not all OSM building models have verified colors

references.name: Milovice older military panel blocks

references.precision: Style-only source; no exact georeferenced 3D model

references.name: Braniborská, Komenského and Spojovací housing reference photos
references.architecture: Renovated panel apartment blocks with colored plaster, horizontal facade divisions, multiple floor levels and repeating balconies.
references.precision: Neighborhood-only architectural reference. Specific buildings have not been individually matched to image locations.

references.name: Rakouská residential facade reference
references.architecture: Contemporary cream and light-gray massing, regular windows, pitched roof and dark rainwater elements.
references.precision: Design direction only; project photograph does not prove nearby buildings share this exterior.

notes: Primary geometry uses OSM outlines. Finer roof & entrance details are not surveyed unless labeled as measured.
Historical 2024 photographs can differ from actual 2026 facades.
Shop location at station follows player report and is provisional; Modrá hvězda, Mírová 243/36, Potraviny 74/4 are georeferenced.
Citywide building footprints extend to Mladá, Benátecká Vrutice and Boží Dar through independent streamed OSM tiles. Only individually grounded buildings should be described as photographic matches.
4.9 changes are geometric and generative material upgrades, not a complete photorealistic city reconstruction.
